subject: Dynamic facility location — kickoff
body:
Hi Alina,

Kickoff for the dynamic facility location workstream, building on our NeurIPS'22 open-source release. The algorithm maintains a near-optimal, stable clustering under a stream of point insertions and deletions — exactly the shape of our retrieval index maintenance problem, where recomputing clusters from scratch on every update burns compute and churns assignments downstream.

Product goal: a clustering backbone for the retrieval stack that stays stable under updates. Milestones: C++ library hardened and benchmarked by May 15, integration prototype against a production update stream by Jun 26, go/no-go for Q3 adoption Jul 10.

Carmen, Emeka, Tereza and Freya are assigned. Staffing and compute plan over to you.

Anders
